chapter: Trent's band: touring, sidemen and breakup
title: Peanuts turns down Dorsey and goes with Barnet
summary: Peanuts rejects offers from a white band, though he later joins Charlie Barnet and goes to Europe.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Somebody like Dorsey--one of the bands like Dorsey--this white band--wanted Peanuts and Peanuts told him to forget about it, he was a friend.
I was playing down here at the Blazer and one of the guys who was playing with Dorsey at the time told me that we tried to grab your trumpet player and he wouldn't come with us.
I know Charlie Barnett wanted him.
